candidates.name: Common Query Language (CQL2) Standard
verified_facts: CQL2 defines a generic filter grammar for selecting subsets of resources from collections.
It provides text and JSON encodings for filter expressions.
semantic_limits: A precise filter predicate changes which records are selected; it does not improve the coordinate, boundary or elevation accuracy of the selected records.

candidates.name: OGC API - Discrete Global Grid Systems Standard
verified_facts: DGGS provides hierarchical geospatial referencing using structured zones or cells.
The OGC API DGGS standard supports retrieval for a requested area, time and resolution of interest using a DGGRS.
semantic_limits: A DGGS zone identifier or refinement level is a referencing/partitioning construct and must not be interpreted as the native accuracy of a LiDAR observation or an exact cadastral boundary.
